segments.cap: When a site has no API, we read the page itself. First, permission. paths_allowed() checks robots.txt for one path. The terms of service count too.
Then three steps with rvest. read_html() downloads the page. html_elements() picks the pieces, with a CSS selector. html_text2() returns their text.
To find a selector: right-click, Inspect, and copy the selector. Or use Selector Gadget.
One selector gives one vector. Check its length against what you see on the page. Twenty jobs should give twenty titles. If you get twenty-three, the selector is too broad.
Put the vectors side by side with data frame.

For many pages, look at how the address changes. Build each address with paste0(), and repeat the scrape in a for loop. Or write your own function, and use map_df(). Pause one second between requests with Sys.sleep().
